_comment: Synthetic hot-water plant (generator hw_plant_lockout, camber.datasets._synthetic; 0.103, #133) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: BLR_FIRE is the burner firing (1 = firing, not an enable), BLR_GAS_KW the boiler's gas input in kW, HWP_STS the hot-water pump's run status and HWP_SPD its speed in %, HWS_T / HWR_T the loop supply and return in F, OAT the outdoor temperature in F. The scenario column selects one plant per ingest run and is not a point.
